meta.title: Wuthering Waves · Shorekeeper Companion
meta.description: Saved over 400 times on Bilibili, the Shorekeeper desktop companion is here to keep you company. Bring the Shorekeeper from Wuthering Waves to your desktop. She keeps you company while you work and wait, changes expressions as tasks progress, and greets completed tasks with a familiar voice. Pat her head, move her around, and choose her animations, voices and lines. Requires Windows 10/11 x64 and local Harness; first use downloads a ~213 MiB desktop application.
